newsitem.title: USA: Kmart October same store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kmart October same store sales up.

text.p: Kmart Crop said Thursday its consolidated same-store sales for the four weeks ended October 30 rose 1.3 percent.
October sales in U.S. Kmart stores increased 1.5 percent on a comparable basis, it added.
Total sales for the month from consolidated operations were $2.44 billion in October, an increase of 0.8 percent versus sales of $2.42 billion for the same period last year.

Sales from consolidated operations for the 39 weeks ended October 30 were $23.74 billion, down 0.5 percent from $23.86 billion a year ago. On a comparable store basis, U.S. Kmart stores rose 2.2 percent for the same period.

"Kmart's sales performance improved slightly during the month," said Floyd Hall, chairman. "Sales performance for the month continued to be led by the consumables area, followed by improved performance in our softlines businesses."
In a statement, Hall said Kmart's hardlines performance was below plan.

"Areas showing particular strength for the month included children's apparel, seasonal consumables and related categories, pharmacy, health and beauty aids, over the counter drugs and photography," he added.

Kmart said it will report December and January comparable sales on a shifted basis that lines up the Christmas holiday in the 1996 and 1995 fiscal periods. This will provide the investment community with the means to measure effectively comparable store sales for the holiday season, Hall said.
Kmart has 2,143 Kmart and 168 Builders Square retail outlets, and operates 129 stores internationally.
